name: sss
description: Personal skill bundle. jira-ticket: write and create Story / Task / Bug / Sub-task tickets in the hyrd Jira, project MAMAS — use when drafting or filing a ticket, rewriting a Description or Acceptance Criteria, or picking a parent epic. release-readiness: read-only report on what is going into the next release — commits since the last release, the tickets they bundle, statuses, blockers, and a suggested next version.
